title: [AUG-208] Auto-bind the default Praxis project to Copilot and Assistant when a live session starts
why_we_need_this:
When a new live session starts, Copilot and Assistant do nothing until the user picks a project with `+` in the ASSISTANT column. The user often forgets to do this, so the meeting runs with no hints and no assistant, and the gap is noticed only later.

The app already stores a default project: `praxisProjects[].isDefault` (the DEFAULT tag, @client/src/services/preferences.ts). Reusing it means Copilot and Assistant work right away with no extra click, and the user still picks a project by hand when the meeting needs a different one.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Starting a recording (Live Text mode or Default-mode / meeting-only socket) when a default project exists opens a tab for that project in the ASSISTANT column, with no click from the user.
- [ ] Copilot binds to the same default project (the per-(liveKey, project) copilotEngine starts) when `aiCopilotMode` is not Off.
- [ ] The Assistant Claude child starts for the default project only when the Active session is enabled and consent is given (`aiSessionEnabled` + `aiConsent`). If they are off, the tab opens in its normal "not started" state and no Claude process is spawned.
- [ ] Copilot Off, Claude Code not signed in, or PraxisOS unreachable: the tab shows the existing marks (○ / !). No error toast, no crash.
- [ ] No default project registered: behaviour is the same as today (no tab opens by itself).
- [ ] Default project folder missing or not a Praxis project: the tab shows `!` unavailable, and the user can still add another project with `+`.
- [ ] The user can close the auto-opened tab or add other projects. The ≤ 3 Claude child limit still holds.
- [ ] Reconnects and "Start Live Text again" (AUG-188) on the same liveKey do not open a second default tab.
- [ ] Compact Mode: the Copilot and Assistant windows show the auto-bound project the same way.
- [ ] Typecheck and existing tests pass. Checked by hand on Windows; the macOS path is reviewed in code (no platform-specific branch is added).
important_constraints:
- Reuse the existing `isDefault` flag on `praxisProjects`. Do not add a new preference or Settings control unless the implementer finds a blocking reason; if so, ask the user first.
- Do not bypass consents or modes: auto-binding only picks the project. All aiCopilotMode / aiSessionEnabled / aiConsent / budget rules stay as they are.
- Keep diagnostics out of the UI (log only).
- Context: See project-context routes `ai-assistants` (AUG-197/199/200), `frontend-design` (ASSISTANT column, `+` picker), `preferences` (praxisProjects). Key code: @server/src/services/assistantSession.ts, @server/src/routes/assistant.ts, and the ASSISTANT column / assistantStore in @client/src.
- Cross-platform: Windows + macOS, path handling via existing helpers only.
